entities.summary: Abū ʿAmr ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAmr al-Awzāʿī was a Sunni Muslim scholar, jurist, theologian, and the chief representative and eponym of the Awza'i school of Islamic jurisprudence.
